operation.description: audit | layout | diff_form | inspect_layout | describe_owner | create_form | import_from_infobase | set_property | bind_handler | unbind_handler | add_element | add_page | remove_page | remove_element | add_column | remove_column | add_command_panel | add_button | add_submenu | add_separator | remove_button | set_action_source | move_element | help (required)

projectName.description: Name of the EDT project whose ordinary forms to read or write.

formFqn.description: The form, Type.Object.Form.Name or CommonForm.Name (Catalog.Products.Form.ItemForm). Alternatively modulePath.

modulePath.description: The form by the address of its module, <dir>/<object>/Forms/<form>/Module.bsl.

dryRun.description: Writing operations: report what the write would do and write nothing (default false).

language.description: Writing operations: the language code of new texts (default ru).

limit.description: audit: how many mismatching or unreadable forms to name (default 20).

details.description: audit: list every form with its version and sizes, capped by limit (default false).

ownerFqn.description: describe_owner: the owner, Type.Object (Catalog.Products, InformationRegister.Prices). create_form: the owner of the new form, Type.Object (Catalog.Products, DataProcessor.Report1).

name.description: create_form: the name of the new form. add_element: the name of the new element. add_page: the name of the new page. remove_page: the name of the page to remove. add_column: the name of the new column. remove_column: the name of the column to remove. add_command_panel: the name of the new panel. add_button: the button's name. add_submenu: the submenu's name. add_separator: the separator's name. remove_button: the button to remove.

purpose.description: create_form: ItemForm (default for an object) | ListForm (default for a register) | ChoiceForm | FolderForm | RecordForm | RecordSetForm | None (no main attribute).

synonym.description: create_form: the form's synonym (default: derived from the name).

title.description: create_form: the form's title (default: the synonym). add_page: the page's title.

width.description: create_form: the form's width, from 500 to 1000 (default 500, or 820 with two columns). set_property: box: the width, instead of right; size: the form's width. add_element: the width, instead of right. add_column: the column's width. add_command_panel: the width, instead of right.

height.description: create_form: the form's height, from 350 to 700 (default: the content, at least 350). set_property: box: the height, instead of bottom; size: the form's height. add_element: the height, instead of bottom. add_command_panel: the height, instead of bottom.

setAsDefault.description: create_form: make it the owner's default form of that purpose (default false).

withFields.description: create_form: lay the header out as labels and fields (default true on an object form).

withTables.description: create_form: lay a table out for each tabular section (default true only for ItemForm with tabular sections).

withCommands.description: create_form: put the form's command panel and a panel on each table (default true except for purpose=None).

columns.description: create_form: 1, 2 or auto (default auto: 1 when the header has 12 attributes or fewer, else 2).

tabularSections.description: create_form: pages or below (default pages when there are two or more, else below).

module.description: import_from_infobase: where the module entry comes from - project (default: the module of the project's current container; refused when the project holds no container, with module=infobase named as the source that has one) or infobase (the exported container's own module).

applicationId.description: import_from_infobase: the infobase to export the form from, when the project has more than one; the default infobase when omitted.

elementName.description: set_property: the element; absent for the form itself. bind_handler: the element whose event to bind; absent for the form. unbind_handler: the element whose event to unbind; absent for the form. remove_element: the element to remove. add_column: the Table. remove_column: the Table. move_element: the element to move.

property.description: set_property: one of title (the form's title, or an element's caption with elementName) | caption (an element's caption (value)) | tooltip (an element's tooltip (value; empty clears)) | size (the form's width and/or height) | box (an element's left, top, right, bottom, or width and height) | visible (an element's visibility (value=true|false)) | enabled (an element's enablement (value=true|false)) | readOnly (a field's read-only flag (value=true|false); measured on a Field alone) | tabs (a panel's tab strip (value=true|false): true draws a tab per page, false leaves the pages to be turned over from code. A panel draws tabs from its second page on) | font (an element's font: value=auto resets it to the form's font, or fontFamily with fontSize (and bold, italic, underline)) | textColor (an element's text colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)) | backColor (an element's background colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)) | borderColor (an element's border colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)) | alignment (the horizontal alignment (value=left|center|right|auto) of a Label, a Button or a Field; a Field has no center) | format (a field's format string (value; empty clears it)) | editFormat (a field's edit format - not measured: the platform reads no ФорматРедактирования and the corpus carries none; refused) | anchor (an element's edge (edge=left|top|right|bottom) bound to the form (value=form), to none (value=none), or to a neighbour (value=<element>.<edge> with offset)).

value.description: set_property: the text for title, caption or tooltip; true|false for visible, enabled, readOnly; auto, #RRGGBB or a style element index for the colours; left|center|right|auto for alignment; auto for the font; form, none or <element>.<edge> for anchor.

left.description: set_property: box: the left edge. add_element: the left edge. add_command_panel: the left edge.

top.description: set_property: box: the top edge. add_element: the top edge. add_command_panel: the top edge.

right.description: set_property: box: the right edge. add_element: the right edge. add_command_panel: the right edge.

bottom.description: set_property: box: the bottom edge. add_element: the bottom edge. add_command_panel: the bottom edge.

fontFamily.description: set_property: font: the family, with fontSize.

fontSize.description: set_property: font: the size, with fontFamily.

bold.description: set_property: font: bold (with fontFamily and fontSize).

italic.description: set_property: font: italic (with fontFamily and fontSize).

underline.description: set_property: font: underline (with fontFamily and fontSize).

edge.description: set_property: anchor: the element's own edge - left, top, right or bottom.

offset.description: set_property: anchor: the offset from the target's edge (default 0).

event.description: bind_handler: the event (ПриИзменении, Нажатие, ПриОткрытии, ...; help lists them). unbind_handler: the event to unbind.

procedure.description: bind_handler: the procedure to bind (default <element><event>, or the event for the form). add_button: the procedure the button runs (the parameters: Кнопка).

stub.description: bind_handler: add an empty procedure with the measured parameters to the module when it declares none (default true). add_button: add an empty procedure with the parameter Кнопка to the module when it declares none (default false).

type.description: add_element: Button | Chart | CheckBox | CommandPanel | Field | FieldHtml | Group | Image | Label | ListField | Panel | RadioBtn | SelectField | Separator | Table | TableField | TextDocumentField; a Table shows the rows data names, and so does a ListField; a TableField, a FieldHtml, a TextDocumentField and a Chart take no data. add_column: String | Number | Date | Boolean, the values' type when data names none.

parent.description: add_element: the Panel to put the element in; absent for the form. add_page: the Panel; absent for the form. remove_page: the Panel; absent for the form. add_command_panel: the Panel to put the panel in; absent for the form. add_button: the submenu to put the button in; absent for the panel itself. add_submenu: the submenu to put it in; absent for the panel itself. add_separator: the submenu to put it in; absent for the panel itself. move_element: the Panel to move the element into, or form for the root.

page.description: add_element: the page of the panel or form; absent for the first. add_command_panel: the page of the panel or form; absent for the first. move_element: the page of that parent.

caption.description: add_element: the caption of a Label, Button, CheckBox, RadioBtn or Group. add_column: the column's caption. add_button: the caption of a procedure button (default the name); a button of a standard action keeps the text the platform gives that action and takes the caption as its tooltip. add_submenu: the caption (default the name).

data.description: add_element: the data path in words, <form attribute>[.<member>...] (СправочникОбъект.Артикул). A TableField, a FieldHtml, a TextDocumentField and a Chart show what their own record or the code sets, so this argument is refused for them; a ListField names the value-list attribute it shows. add_column: the member or standard attribute of the row (Код, Наименование, Номенклатура, НомерСтроки), or the column of the value table.

cascade.description: remove_element: remove an element command panels take their actions from, clearing the source and the auto-fill of those panels (default false).

editable.description: add_column: the cell gets an editor (default true); given together with control, the two must agree.

control.description: add_column: the cell's control: field, checkBox, selectField, none (default field when editable, none otherwise); a pair of control and value type outside the measured ones is refused

actionSource.description: add_command_panel: the Table the panel takes its actions from; absent or none for no source.

autoFill.description: add_command_panel: whether the platform fills the panel's buttons itself (default true with an actionSource, false without one). set_action_source: whether the platform fills the panel's buttons itself (default true with a table, false with none).

panel.description: add_button: the command panel that takes the button. add_submenu: the command panel that takes the submenu. add_separator: the command panel that takes the separator. remove_button: the command panel that holds the button. set_action_source: the command panel.

action.description: add_button: a standard action: one of close, write, writeAndClose, help, add, change, delete, copy, moveUp, moveDown, sortAscending, sortDescending, finishEditing, filterByValue, disableFilter, saveValues, restoreValues, copyObject, reread, findInList, refresh, listSettings, outputList, select, enableAll, disableAll, back, forward, newGroup, findInTree, moveToGroup, hierarchy, viewByOwner, searchByNumber, setFilterAndSort, post, unpost, editInDialog, markDeletion, setFilter, enterOnBasis.

picture.description: add_button: the index of the picture dictionary of a standard action (0 to 3; default the picture the corpus most often writes for the action).

before.description: add_button: a button of the same block to put the button in front of. add_submenu: a button of the same block to put the submenu in front of. add_separator: a button of the same block to put the separator in front of.

table.description: set_action_source: the Table the panel takes its actions from; none clears the source.

operations: audit - every ordinary form of the project: layout version, container entries, module size, byte-for-byte round trip of the layout text; details=true lists forms, limit caps the lists

layout - one form (formFqn or modulePath): title, attributes with types, pages, form handlers with events and the element tree - type, name, caption, tooltip, box, page, data path, handlers, buttons of a command panel

diff_form - one form (formFqn or modulePath) against HEAD: whether the layout entry and the module entry changed, and the names of the other entries added, removed or changed; a changed module is left to diff_module at the module's address; when there is nothing to compare with, revision names the outcome

inspect_layout - one form (formFqn or modulePath), read-only: findings over the layout the reader yields - duplicate ids and names in their namespaces, references to pages, elements, attributes, action sources and anchor targets the layout does not hold, handlers the module does not declare, invalid boxes, anchor cycles - and warnings for siblings of one page that overlap (a Group or Panel frame never a party) and a child past its parent's box; the coverage names what was and was not checked, and nothing is corrected
describe_owner - ownerFqn (Type.Object): the owner's attributes, tabular sections, standard attributes and list columns, in words, with no uuid

create_form - ownerFqn, name, purpose (ItemForm | ListForm | ChoiceForm | FolderForm | RecordForm | RecordSetForm | None), synonym, title, width, height, setAsDefault, withFields, withTables, withCommands, columns (1 | 2 | auto), tabularSections (pages | below): the form's entry on its owner and the container Forms/<name>/Form.oform. The layout is the owner's header, its tabular sections and its command panels; the file, the model entry and the baseline mark are three steps, and a failure of the file or the model removes the file

import_from_infobase - formFqn (or modulePath), module (project | infobase, default project), applicationId: the form's container pulled out of the project's infobase into the project. The layout and every other entry of the container come from the infobase, the module entry from the chosen source; a handler the infobase layout binds that the chosen module does not declare stops the write and is named in the answer

set_property - property=title (of the form, or of an element with elementName) | caption | tooltip (value) | box (left, top, right, bottom or width, height) of elementName | size (width, height) of the form | visible, enabled, readOnly, tabs (value=true|false) | font (value=auto, or fontFamily with fontSize, bold, italic, underline) | textColor, backColor, borderColor (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index) | alignment (value=left|center|right|auto) | format (value, empty clears) | editFormat (refused) | anchor (edge=left|top|right|bottom, value=form|none|<element>.<edge>, offset) of elementName
bind_handler - event + procedure (default <element><event>) of elementName, or of the form without elementName; stub=true adds an empty procedure with the measured parameters to the module
unbind_handler - event of elementName or of the form

add_element - type, name, parent (a Panel) and page, left/top/right/bottom or width/height, caption, tooltip, data (a path in words: <form attribute>.<member>); the record is the measured template of the type with the element's own values put in
add_page - name and title of a page of the form or of parent (a Panel)
remove_page - name of a page of the form or of parent (a Panel); a page with elements on it or the last page is refused

remove_element - elementName, with its children, data bindings and the anchors that named it; an element a command panel takes its actions from is refused unless cascade=true, which clears the source and the auto-fill of those panels

add_column - elementName (a Table), name, caption, data (a member or standard attribute of the row, or the value table's column), type (String | Number | Date | Boolean when data names none), width, editable, control (the cell's control); the kind of column follows what the rows are: a list of an object, a tabular section, a value table or tree
remove_column - elementName (a Table) and name

add_command_panel - name, the box (left/top/right/bottom or width/height), parent and page, actionSource (a Table of the form) and autoFill (true with a source, false without one); add_element type=CommandPanel writes the same panel without a source

add_button - panel + name + caption (a standard action keeps its own text and takes the caption as its tooltip), and exactly one of procedure (a procedure of the form module, stub=true adds an empty one) and action (a registered standard action); picture is the index of the measured dictionary; parent puts the button in a submenu, before in front of a named button of the same block
add_submenu - panel + name + caption of a submenu, with parent and before as of a button; the submenu gets an empty buttons block of its own - add_button parent=<submenu> fills it
add_separator - panel + name of a separator, with parent and before as of a button
remove_button - panel + name: a button, a separator or a submenu with every button under it; the action records nothing references any more go with it
set_action_source - panel + table (a Table of the form, or none): sets the source and autoFill=true, or clears both; autoFill=false keeps the source without the platform filling the buttons
move_element - elementName to parent (a Panel, or form) and page; the box stays; anchors between the element and the neighbours the move separates are released both ways and listed
help - this catalogue

properties.title: the form's title, or an element's caption with elementName
properties.caption: an element's caption (value)
properties.box: an element's left, top, right, bottom, or width and height
properties.readOnly: a field's read-only flag (value=true|false); measured on a Field alone
properties.tabs: a panel's tab strip (value=true|false): true draws a tab per page, false leaves the pages to be turned over from code. A panel draws tabs from its second page on
properties.font: an element's font: value=auto resets it to the form's font, or fontFamily with fontSize (and bold, italic, underline)
properties.textColor: an element's text colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)
properties.backColor: an element's background colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)
properties.borderColor: an element's border colour (value=auto | #RRGGBB | a style element index)
properties.alignment: the horizontal alignment (value=left|center|right|auto) of a Label, a Button or a Field; a Field has no center
properties.format: a field's format string (value; empty clears it)
properties.editFormat: a field's edit format - not measured: the platform reads no ФорматРедактирования and the corpus carries none; refused
properties.anchor: an element's edge (edge=left|top|right|bottom) bound to the form (value=form), to none (value=none), or to a neighbour (value=<element>.<edge> with offset)

generalHelp.writes: Every writing operation takes dryRun; a write rewrites only the records the operation names, and marks the form's owner in the sync baselines so update_database carries the form.
generalHelp.whatAnOrdinaryFormIs: A form of the thick client's ordinary application mode. EDT keeps it as Form.oform - a platform container with two text entries, 'form' (the layout in the platform's brace format) and 'module' (BSL) - and does not open it in any editor.

caption.description: the caption of a procedure button (default the name); a button of a standard action keeps the text the platform gives that action and takes the caption as its tooltip.

procedure.description: the procedure the button runs (the parameters: Кнопка).

action.description: a standard action: one of close, write, writeAndClose, help, add, change, delete, copy, moveUp, moveDown, sortAscending, sortDescending, finishEditing, filterByValue, disableFilter, saveValues, restoreValues, copyObject, reread, findInList, refresh, listSettings, outputList, select, enableAll, disableAll, back, forward, newGroup, findInTree, moveToGroup, hierarchy, viewByOwner, searchByNumber, setFilterAndSort, post, unpost, editInDialog, markDeletion, setFilter, enterOnBasis.

picture.description: the index of the picture dictionary of a standard action (0 to 3; default the picture the corpus most often writes for the action).

parent.description: the submenu to put the button in; absent for the panel itself.

before.description: a button of the same block to put the button in front of.

stub.description: add an empty procedure with the parameter Кнопка to the module when it declares none (default false).

add_submenu.summary: panel + name + caption of a submenu, with parent and before as of a button; the submenu gets an empty buttons block of its own - add_button parent=<submenu> fills it

panel.description: the command panel that takes the submenu.

parent.description: the submenu to put it in; absent for the panel itself.

before.description: a button of the same block to put the submenu in front of.

add_separator.summary: panel + name of a separator, with parent and before as of a button

panel.description: the command panel that takes the separator.

parent.description: the submenu to put it in; absent for the panel itself.

before.description: a button of the same block to put the separator in front of.

remove_button.summary: panel + name: a button, a separator or a submenu with every button under it; the action records nothing references any more go with it

panel.description: the command panel that holds the button.

set_action_source.summary: panel + table (a Table of the form, or none): sets the source and autoFill=true, or clears both; autoFill=false keeps the source without the platform filling the buttons

table.description: the Table the panel takes its actions from; none clears the source.

autoFill.description: whether the platform fills the panel's buttons itself (default true with a table, false with none).

move_element.summary: elementName to parent (a Panel, or form) and page; the box stays; anchors between the element and the neighbours the move separates are released both ways and listed

parent.description: the Panel to move the element into, or form for the root.
